page.overview:
Who is Goober?

is a raccoon played by Travis Willingham for .

Goober is a raccoon with brown fur. The hair on his head is slightly slicked upward and held in place by a pair of engineer goggles and he wears a red bandanna around his neck. He appears to have an oral fixation as his official artwork depicts him as carrying a bolt in his teeth.
